comment: The two audio outputs are the two pipes, not a stereo pair: the panel prints MAIN and SEC. while the maker's port names read "Audio L" and "Audio R" (Aulos.cpp:417). A voice that is asleep writes 0V to all four outputs and skips its whole model (Aulos.cpp:1185), so the module costs almost nothing while silent.
